title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → Institution

source_tables.description: Academic institution setup (effective-dated). One row per INSTITUTION code: description, short description, country, and default settings.
Campuses under each institution. Map campuses as locations, not separate HELIX Institutions, unless they report to IPEDS separately.
External organizations, including other colleges (EXT_ORG_TYPE = SCHL). Source for Institution rows that represent transfer and prior schools.
External org identifiers such as ATP/CEEB and FICE codes. FLAG: record name varies by release; confirm.

notes: Most schools have one home INSTITUTION and hundreds of external schools. Load both: the home institution from PS_INSTITUTION_TBL and external schools from PS_EXT_ORG_TBL, so TransferCredit and ContinuingEducation can point at real Institution rows. Take the current effective-dated row (max EFFDT <= today, EFF_STATUS = 'A').

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from INSTITUTION (home) or EXT_ORG_ID (external).
Official name. Use the full legal name, not the 10-character short form.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_INSTITUTION_TBL.INSTITUTION; external org ID records; configuration
attribute_mappings.transformation: Array of {system, value}: peoplesoft_institution (INSTITUTION), ipeds_unit_id, opeid (8-digit, from FA setup or configuration), fice, ceeb/atp. IPEDS and OPEID usually come from configuration or the IPEDS directory file, not a PeopleSoft field.
Map from IPEDS level and control: 4-year -> university or college, 2-year -> community_college or technical_college. Not stored in PeopleSoft.
PeopleSoft stores 3-letter codes (USA). Convert to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US).
Two-letter state or ISO 3166-2 subdivision. FLAG: home institution address may sit on a location record.
Load from the Carnegie Classification public file by IPEDS Unit ID. Refresh when a new edition is published.
IANA name, for example America/New_York. Set once per institution or campus.
'peoplesoft' for the home institution. Null for external schools.
FLAG: URL field is not populated at most schools; fall back to the IPEDS directory file.
